# Toggle

> A 40×40 icon button that stays on or off, alone or as one choice in a group.

| | |
|---|---|
| Kind | component |
| Contract | `stable` · [toggle.contract.yaml](../../contracts/toggle.contract.yaml) |
| Guidance | `agreed` |
| Source | [Figma 168:1149](https://www.figma.com/design/1Zy0wiWKXQAvsfDBX3KR0d/UI-Kit-v01?node-id=168-1149) · read 2026-08-19 · frozen 2026-10-20 |
| Implemented in | Accounting app (`src/rost/toggle/Toggle.tsx`, `.rost-toggle`) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selected` | boolean |  | `false` |
| `icon` | slot |  |  |
| `label` | slot |  |  |
| `labelled` | boolean |  | `false` |

## States

`Default` · `Hover` · `Pressed` · `Focus` · `Disabled`

## Anatomy

- `root`
- `background`: The see-through plate when it's off, on its own layer so the icon stays solid.
- `icons-arrow-left`: The 20px icon slot. Its colour is the action's `icon` token: primary when it's on, secondary when it's off.
- `label`: Not in Figma, which has no labelled toggle. Body type, medium, with tabular numbers so years line up. Its colour follows the state, the way a button's label does.
- `glyph`: Figma's arrow, drawn as a mask in the icon's colour. A caller's own icon replaces it and should use `currentColor`.
- `focus-ring`

## When to use

- **On and off, straight away.** Switching a view or a filter on and off, when the change happens straight away.
- **One of a short set.** Used to pick one option from a short set, as a group: a year switcher, a view switcher.

## When not to use

- **Doing something.** Doing something. That's **IconButton**. A toggle remembers, a button doesn't.
- **A settings switch.** A setting that's on or off, with a label. That's **Switch**.

## Behaviour

It changes with `selected` and `state`. Off, it's a plate with 12px corners on the secondary surface, faded down. On, it becomes a fully round primary pill. The change of shape is part of the signal, not just the colour.

## Accessibility

- **Alone**: `<button aria-pressed="true|false">`.
- **Group**: `role="radio"` with `aria-checked`, inside **ToggleGroup**, which is the named `role="radiogroup"` and does the keys: arrows move between options and choose, Tab gets you in and out.
- **Name**: `aria-label` when it's icon only.
- **Focus**: `focus-ring` (2px, `actions/primary/focus/focus-ring` when it's on), on `:focus-visible`.
- **Colour**: on and off show in the shape (12px corners to fully round) as well as the colour.

## Content

An icon, or a short text label: a year, a number, one word. The label makes the toggle grow wider than 40px, and it never wraps. Figma only draws the icon-only one.
